messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"description": "The creature is a quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile, with the overall body shape, fur, head, and paws of a brown bear but with large glossy beetle exoskeleton elements fused to its body. It is covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is darker on the lower legs and lighter tan on the muzzle and along the mid-flank. A single large curved black horn rises from the forehead, a large dark reddish-brown shield-like plate covers the shoulders and upper chest, and two large oval ridged wing-covers sit on the back and on the outer side of the hindquarter. Two rows of small oval holes run along the side of the torso, and narrow segmented dark bands encircle each leg near the joints. It stands on four thick legs with clawed paws and has a very short furry tail at the rear.", "parts": [{"part": "head", "looks_like": "bear-like head at the front of the body with an elongated snout, black nose, small brown eyes, and light tan fur on the muzzle, covered in shaggy brown fur", "where": "at the anterior end of the body, facing to the right"}, {"part": "horns", "looks_like": "single large, glossy, dark brown to black, smooth, upward-curving horn with a small forked notch on the inner curve near the tip and a broad base", "where": "arising from the center of the forehead between the ears on top of the head"}, {"part": "ears", "looks_like": "two small, rounded, furry ears with dense brown fur", "where": "on top of the head, one on each side of the horn base"}, {"part": "legs", hips, supporting the body"}, {"part": "feet", "looks_like": "four broad paws with thick fur and five long, curved, light-colored claws on each visible paw", "where": "at the bottom ends of each leg in
